verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe a terminal view where you can watch commands as they run and see output logs. They also describe an Interactive Browser and IDE where you can follow and take over the agent's work, which covers the core of real-time observation. Explicit session status indicators are not documented; the session management exposed via MCP only implies them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a current-status indicator (e.g. working/blocked/finished), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the live-watch experience.
